t0: opencode context payload skeleton — survey only, no emission logic

pinned_package.name: @opencode/plugin
pinned_package.authority: tarball .d.ts files below (opencode.ai/docs/plugin/ returns 404; opencode.ai/docs/plugins/ covers v1 only)

registration_verbatim.session_domain: export type SessionDomain = Pick<SessionApi, "list" | "create" | "get" | "remove" | "switchAgent" | "switchModel" | "prompt" | "generate" | "command" | "compact" | "synthetic" | "interrupt" | "update" | "move" | "wait" | "context"> & { readonly hook: ModelHooks<SessionHooks>; };
registration_verbatim.note: No standalone session.context() call exists on SessionDomain. Registration is ctx.session.hook("context", callback).

hook_signature_verbatim.model_hooks: export type ModelHooks<Spec> = <Name extends keyof Spec>(name: Name, callback: (input: Spec[Name]) => Promise<void> | void, options?: Spec[Name] extends { readonly model: unknown } ? ModelHookOptions : never) => Promise<Registration>;
hook_signature_verbatim.registration: export interface Registration { readonly dispose: () => Promise<void>; }

plugin_entry_verbatim.define: export declare function define(plugin: Plugin): Plugin;
plugin_entry_verbatim.plugin: export interface Plugin { readonly id: string; readonly setup: (context: Context) => Promise<Cleanup | void> | Cleanup | void; }
plugin_entry_verbatim.session_on_context: session is one domain on Context (readonly session: SessionDomain)

session_context_fields_verbatim.session_request: export interface SessionRequest { readonly sessionID: Session.ID; readonly model: Model.Ref; system: Array<SystemPart>; messages: Array<Message>; options: SessionRequestOptions; }
session_context_fields_verbatim.session_context: export interface SessionContext extends SessionRequest { readonly agent: Agent.ID; tools: Record<string, { description: string; input: JsonSchema.JsonSchema; }>; }
session_context_fields_verbatim.mutability: system, messages, tools are mutable on the input object; sessionID, model, agent are readonly

v1_fallback_signatures.authority: NOT in the 2.1.4 tarball (v2 promise/effect API only; grep for chat.params/system.transform/tool.definition across dist/promise/*.d.ts and dist/*.d.ts returns no match). Pinned from the live-proven Kilo precedent at dash/src/capture/kilo-plugin/source.ts, which runs on the same v1 fork surface.
v1_fallback_signatures.chat.params: async (input, output) — input carries sessionID, message { id }, agent, model { id }, provider { info.id | id }
v1_fallback_signatures.experimental.chat.system.transform: async (input, output) — input carries sessionID; output.system is the assembled system-parts array
v1_fallback_signatures.tool.definition: async (input, output) — input carries toolID; output carries description and jsonSchema (fallback: parameters)

file_installed_dir_loadability.conclusion: a file-installed directory is a legal v2 plugin target
